lines.en: I hover as I walk, feet just off the ground.

lines.zh: 推进器的声响比脚步更响
lines.en: My thrusters are louder than my steps.

lines.zh: 这具身体比旧版更利落
lines.en: This body is sleeker than the old one.

lines.zh: 我从岩架上落下，稳稳站住
lines.en: I drop from the ledge and land steady.

lines.zh: 骨头外面裹着一层金属
lines.en: Metal sheathes the bone.

lines.zh: 我走得不歪，从头到尾一条线
lines.en: I walk dead straight, line to line.

lines.zh: 肩上的炮管随我一起转
lines.en: The shoulder cannons turn with me.

lines.zh: 我碾过灰，留下浅浅的印
lines.en: I crush the ash into shallow prints.

lines.zh: 我朝你走，没有多余的动作
lines.en: I walk at you with no wasted motion.
I step across a fissure.
The ground is soft, so I float more.

lines.zh: 我不转身，直接横着移过去
lines.en: I do not turn; I slide sideways.

lines.zh: 后面拖着一条淡淡的烟
lines.en: A faint smoke trail drags behind me.
When I stop, there is no drift.

lines.zh: 我的步幅一致，像在计时
lines.en: My strides are even, as if timed.
I accelerate until it is a charge.
I hang midair, barely moving.
The thrusters hum low, ready.

lines.zh: 我的眼眶里是红色的光点
lines.en: Red points glow in my sockets.

lines.zh: 金属件自己校准了一次
lines.en: The metal parts self-calibrate once.
I am computing your movement path.

lines.zh: 这里的空气太脏，烧起来更旺
lines.en: The air here is dirty; it burns hotter.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一具展品
lines.en: I stand motionless, like a display piece.

lines.zh: 我的骨头已经不属于我了
lines.en: These bones are no longer mine.

lines.zh: 我等的时间，比你想的长
lines.en: I have waited longer than you think.

lines.zh: 肩炮慢慢转过来，对上了你
lines.en: The shoulder cannon slowly turns to face you.
I make no breathing motion.

lines.zh: 我的红眼对上了你的眼
lines.en: My red eyes meet yours.
You came earlier than the last batch.
I scan you head to foot.
I can see your gear clearly.
I neither retreat nor advance.
I angle the shoulder cannon down.
Your breathing quickened; I hear it.
I am waiting for you to fire first.
Narrow here, which favors me.

lines.zh: 你看起来不像能撑多久
lines.en: You do not look like you will last long.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲裂了，我扫了一眼
lines.en: My shoulder plate cracks; I glance at it.
That knocked me off heading.
I do not cry out; I recalculate.
The shell dents in one spot.

lines.zh: 我落低了一点，又升回去
lines.en: I dip lower, then rise again.

lines.zh: 损伤报告在我体内亮起
lines.en: A damage report lights inside me.
I pull back and reload the belt.
Bone intact, metal bent.
I stare at you longer now.
That is not enough to take me apart.
That is not Argent.

lines.zh: 你举着它，我只看着你的手
lines.en: You hold it up; I watch only your hand.
I do not eat; I only burn.

lines.zh: 把能量给我，我会更彻底
lines.en: Give me energy and I will be thorough.
I reach out to reach you.

lines.zh: 这东西在你手里没有用
lines.en: That is useless in your hand.
I could flatten it underfoot.
I drift forward a block.
We collide with a bright metallic clang.
The impact sets me drifting aside.

lines.zh: 我稳住推进器，回到原位
lines.en: I steady the thrusters and return.

lines.zh: 你撞上来的力，我吸收了
lines.en: I absorb the force of your charge.
A plate on my shoulder dents.
I am heavier; you are thrown back.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的计时
lines.en: That broke my timing.
Sparks spray from the contact point.
I re-align on your direction.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一段烧过的地面
lines.en: A stretch of scorched ground lies between us.

lines.zh: 改造过的东西没有这一类
lines.en: Reforged things have no such thing.

lines.zh: 同型号的，会站在同一侧
lines.en: Same model, same side.

lines.zh: 我们两个一起覆盖一片区域
lines.en: Together we cover one area.
No language, only sync.

lines.zh: 肩炮互相对齐，校准完成
lines.en: Cannons align; calibration complete.
Back to back, our fire lanes cross.

lines.zh: 同一处战场的两具残骸
lines.en: Two wrecks from the same field.

lines.zh: 我们没有过去，只有任务
lines.en: We have no past, only tasking.
When we advance together, the ground lights up.
One falls, the other continues.
Metal fingers pinch it, steady.
I scan it; useless.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进胸口的结构
lines.en: I slot it into the chest frame.

lines.zh: 它在我手里被烫出印子
lines.en: It scorches in my grip.
I lift it; too light.
I throw it into the lava.
I roll my wrist and drop it.
This could serve as a shim.
I carry it one-handed without effort.

lines.zh: 我把它按在炮口上比对
lines.en: I hold it against the muzzle to compare.
Scan complete: locked.
You are inside my firing arc.

lines.zh: 我把两条火线交叉在你身上
lines.en: I cross both fire lanes on you.
Range compressed to firing distance.

lines.zh: 你转身的方向我已经算好
lines.en: I have already calculated your turn.
I do not shout; I fire.
You cannot jump to this height.

lines.zh: 我悬起来，把你框在下面
lines.en: I rise and frame you below.
You retreat toward lava; that is a dead end.
My red eyes brighten.
Target heat confirmed.
This round, I hold nothing back.

lines.zh: 我悬在你上方，慢慢平移
lines.en: I hover above you, sliding slowly.

lines.zh: 你每换一个掩体，我就换一个角度
lines.en: Each new cover you take, I take a new angle.

lines.zh: 推进器的声音一直没停
lines.en: The thrusters never go quiet.

lines.zh: 我在压缩距离，一格一格
lines.en: I compress the distance, block by block.

lines.zh: 你在我下面，抬头很费劲
lines.en: You are below me; looking up is difficult.

lines.zh: 我不落地，落地是旧版的习惯
lines.en: I do not land; landing is an old habit.
I have memorized your trajectory.
I strafe out of your sights.

lines.zh: 你在跑，我跟着烧过的地面走
lines.en: You run; I follow the scorched ground.
My shoulder cannon keeps micro-adjusting.

lines.zh: 你一开火，我就知道位置了
lines.en: When you fire, I know where you are.
This open ground offers no cover.

lines.zh: 我从上面压下来，速度很快
lines.en: I drop from above, fast.
For the last stretch, I stop drifting.
I kick down and the rock cracks.
The cannon fires at point-blank.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的领口往上提
lines.en: I take your collar and lift.

lines.zh: 金属的拳头砸在你的护甲上
lines.en: A metal fist hits your armor.
You stagger; I press in.
That nearly flipped you over.

lines.zh: 我的推进器反推，增加冲击
lines.en: My thrusters counter-burn to add force.
Bone and metal drive together.

lines.zh: 你挡得住一下，挡不住两下
lines.en: You can block one, not two.
I hover back and re-align.
Sparks land at your feet.

lines.zh: 这一轮我用的是近距火力
lines.en: This time I used close-range fire.
The sound of metal grinding comes first.

lines.zh: 我从上方的裂口落下来
lines.en: I drop through a rift above.

lines.zh: 推进器一开，灰全被吹散
lines.en: Thrusters ignite and blast the ash away.
This body has been reforged.

lines.zh: 红眼在下界的暗里亮起
lines.en: Red eyes light in the nether dark.

lines.zh: 我扫描了一遍这片地形
lines.en: I scan the terrain once.

lines.zh: 旧的那批还在，我不一样
lines.en: The old batch is still here; I am different.
The purge begins.
Fire burns me and only feels slow.

lines.zh: 我砸在地上，砸出一个坑
lines.en: I slam down and crater the ground.

lines.zh: 液体进了推进器，我往上挣
lines.en: Liquid floods my thrusters; I strain upward.
The blast hurls me sideways.

lines.zh: 一发打进我的胸甲，卡住了
lines.en: A round lodges in my chest plate.

lines.zh: 那股力让我的校准乱了
lines.en: That force scrambles my calibration.
I consume nothing; I cannot starve.
Lightning runs the length of my shell.
Even the lava is gone beneath me.
